# Lattitude

> > Lattitude is an employee engagement and career development platform that combines mentorship, career mapping, and personal advisory networks to drive professional growth and talent retention.

Lattitude provides organizations with integrated tools for employee development, including mentorship programs, career mapping features, engagement surveys, and the Pathfinders framework. The platform is supported by educational resources including the Pathfinders book, online course, and podcast featuring founder Pete Schramm.

## Key Topics

- Career Mapping
- Mentorship Platform
- Employee Engagement
- Personal Board of Advisors
- Pathfinders Framework
- Professional Growth
- Talent Retention

- [Engagement Surveys](https://golattitude.com/engagement-surveys): Engagement survey tool for employee feedback and analytics
